name: P01
title: Postoperative Rehabilitation Initiation
description: The patient undergoes surgery procedure. One week later, a specialist follow-up visit is performed. Subsequently, the patient completes a clinical questionnaire and receives education on generic home rehabilitation program. The patient then performs the rehabilitation exercises daily for four weeks.

name: P02
title: Heart Failure Follow-up Management
description: The patient completes a post-stroke follow up questionnaire. Thereafter, vital signs are monitored for ten days, and the practitioner is alerted with urgent priority if abnormal values are detected. In parallel, the patient attends a cardiology specialist follow-up visit and subsequently receives post-stroke lifestyle education.

name: P03
title: Diabetes Monitoring and Treatment Adjustment
description: The patient monitors blood glucose every morning. If the blood glucose level exceeds the prescribed threshold, the practitioner is notified as soon as possible. Otherwise, the patient performs a 30-minute walking session.

name: P04
title: Post-surgical Infection Monitoring
description: Every morning the patient applies the prescribed medication and measures body temperature. If body temperature exceeds 38°C, a post-surgical infection screening questionnaire is administered and then the practitioner is alerted as urgent.

name: P05
title: Chronic Kidney Disease Follow-up
description: The patient undergoes a urine laboratory examination every three months. Following the results, the patient attends a nephrology specialist visit, during which a low-sodium diet is recommended and fluid management education is provided.

name: P06
title: Cardiac Rehabilitation After Myocardial Infarction
description: The patient undergoes cardiac rehabilitation therapy. After that, the patient performs aerobic exercises three times per day while monitoring heart rate. The patient subsequently completes a general health questionnaire.

name: P07
title: Oncology Chemotherapy Monitoring Pathway
description: Following blood sample collection, if laboratory results are normal, chemotherapy is administered while vital signs are monitored. Otherwise, the practitioner is alerted and an ECG performed.

name: P08
title: Stroke Rehabilitation Pathway
description: Following neurological imaging with brain MRI, the patient begins physiotherapy once a week and performs home exercises once daily. In parallel, the patient completes a clinical questionnaire once a month. After that, the patient attends a cardiology follow-up visit.

name: P09
title: COPD Exacerbation Management
description: The patient undergoes respiratory observation and SpO₂ monitoring. If abnormal findings are detected, the practitioner is alerted as soon as possible. Bronchodilator medication is administered. The patient receives education on correct inhaler use and daily self-management strategies.

name: P10
title: Multimodal Preoperative Optimization Pathway
description: The patient completes anamnesis, followed by blood sample collection, ECG recording, and chest X-ray examination. The patient then undergoes an anaesthesia consultation and receives preoperative education regarding the surgical procedure.

name: P11
title: Hypertension Management Pathway
description: The patient completes a general health questionnaire twice a day and measures blood pressure. If blood pressure is between the defined low and high thresholds, the practitioner is alerted urgently; if it exceeds the high threshold, the emergency team is alerted with stat priority. The patient takes ramipril 2.5 mg once daily. Every six months, the patient attends a cardiology specialist follow-up visit.

name: P12
title: Postoperative Pain Management Pathway
description: The patient completes a pain assessment survey. Analgesic treatment is administered, followed by routine alerting of the practitioner.

name: P13
title: Osteoarthritis Conservative Treatment Pathway
description: The patient attends a monthly rheumatology specialist visit. The patient receives medication administration and performs prescribed exercises.

name: P14
title: Asthma Long-term Control Pathway
description: The patient completes a general health questionnaire every day. Then respiratory parameters are monitored for 30 minutes. If abnormal respiratory parameters are detected, the practitioner is alerted urgently. Otherwise, the patient is educated on correct inhaler use.

name: P15
title: Diabetic Foot Care Pathway
description: The patient undergoes wound specimen collection. If an ulcer is detected, the patient attends a general surgery specialist visit. If signs of infection worsen, the clinical team is alerted and therapeutic intervention is initiated. Otherwise, the patient receives education on home wound care and medication guidelines.

name: P16
title: Pulmonary Rehabilitation Pathway
description: The patient attends a respiratory disease specialist visit. Subsequently, the patient performs the prescribed exercises three times per week while undergoing SpO₂ monitoring. If oxygen saturation falls below the prescribed threshold, the practitioner is alerted.

name: P17
title: Anticoagulation Monitoring Pathway
description: The patient takes anticoagulant therapy at a dose of 5 mg twice daily. Independently, laboratory examinations are performed every month. If abnormal results are detected, a routine notification is issued.

name: P18
title: Breast Cancer Diagnostic Pathway
description: The patient undergoes mammography followed by breast ultrasound examination. If the results require further investigation, a breast examination is performed. If indicated by the specialist, a breast biopsy is subsequently carried out.

name: P19
title: Frailty Assessment Pathway
description: The patient completes a general health questionnaire and subsequently attends a geriatric specialist visit. Following the clinical assessment, the patient receives education on the prescribed care plan. Thereafter, the patient performs the prescribed exercises for 30 minutes and follows a protein-rich Mediterranean diet with adequate hydration and soft-textured foods.

name: P20
title: Chronic Wound Management Pathway
description: The patient completes a wound assessment survey and undergoes specimen collection. If infection is suspected, therapeutic intervention is initiated. Subsequently, the patient follows a high-protein, micronutrient-dense diet rich in vitamin C and zinc, with optimal hydration and strict glycemic control, while takes amoxicillin 1 g every 8 hours for 7 days, and attends a follow-up visit after four weeks.
